name: apb-base
description: Shared base runtime image and entrypoint framework for all APBs, providing action dispatch, OpenShift authentication, and bind credential lifecycle management.

name: etherpad-apb
description: Deploys Etherpad Lite collaborative note-taking application backed by MariaDB on OpenShift, provisioning PersistentVolumeClaims, Services, a Route, and DeploymentConfigs.

name: hastebin-apb
description: Deploys Hastebin pastebin-style web app with a Memcached sidecar on OpenShift, using a Jinja2-templated ConfigMap for configuration and a multi-container DeploymentConfig.

name: jenkins-apb
description: Deploys Jenkins CI/CD server on OpenShift with optional persistence, OAuth integration, TLS edge-terminated Route, and optional Source-to-Image custom build support.

name: mediawiki123-apb
description: Deploys MediaWiki 1.23 on OpenShift using a pre-built image, provisioning a PVC, DeploymentConfig, Service, and Route with a separate deprovision and test playbook.

name: nginx-oss-apb
description: Deploys NGINX OSS as a reverse proxy or static web server on OpenShift with optional load balancing, using a Jinja2-generated ConfigMap for NGINX configuration.

name: pyzip-demo-apb
description: Deploys the py-zip-demo Python web application on OpenShift with zero required parameters, provisioning a Route, Service, and DeploymentConfig with a ConfigChange trigger.

name: pyzip-demo-db-apb
description: Deploys a PostGIS-enabled PostgreSQL database seeded with geospatial demo data on OpenShift, emitting bind credentials via asb_encode_binding for consumption by pyzip-demo-apb.
